name: Diskon
description: Price cut, usually shown as a percentage or a strikethrough price.

name: Beli X Gratis Y
description: Buy some, get more free. Record price = total paid and quantity = total packs received.

name: Bundling / Paket
description: Several packs sold together at one price. Record the bundle price and quantity.

name: Tebus Murah (PWP)
description: Low price that needs a minimum spend. Record min_purchase.

name: Harga Member
description: Only for loyalty-card or app members. Set member_only.

name: Cashback
description: Money back after paying. Only guaranteed cashback counts toward the effective price.

name: Voucher / Kode Promo
description: Needs a voucher or code. Record the price after the voucher.

name: Flash Sale
description: Very short window, usually online. Always set valid_until.
